units.source_text: 他晒得黝黑，从深戴的制帽帽舌下露出了挺秀的鼻梁，从头到脚都勃勃有生气，一派英雄的气概。

en.t: He was deeply tanned, and beneath the brim of the cap pulled low on his head his fine straight nose showed; from head to foot he brimmed with vitality and had an air of heroic spirit.

units.source_text: 在低班同学面前，他畅谈了纪律严格的生活。

en.t: In front of the younger students, he spoke at length about a life of strict discipline.

units.source_text: 然而，他在讲述这种理应是凄惨的生活时，却用了仿佛叙说奢侈豪华的生活的口吻。

en.t: Yet when he described this life, which ought to have been miserable, he used a tone as though he were recounting a life of luxury and splendor.

units.source_text: 他一举手一投足都充满了自豪和稚嫩，完全懂得自己的谦逊的分量。

en.t: Every gesture and movement of his was filled with pride and childishness, and he understood perfectly the weight of his own humility.

units.source_text: 他的制服胸前饰有蛇腹形饰线，他挺起的胸膛活像迎着风浪前进的船首。

en.t: The breast of his uniform was decorated with braided frogging, and his thrust-out chest looked just like the prow of a ship advancing into wind and waves.
